description: This file defines the WebBridge class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the class's interface, including nested classes, enums, member variables, and method signatures related to plugin management, WebSocket communication, and JSON-RPC message handling.

classes.name: WebBridge
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin, dispatcher, and WebSocket interfaces, managing plugin lifecycle, message routing, and observer subscriptions.

classes.name: WebBridge::Observer
classes.description: Represents an observer with an ID and designator, supporting comparison operators.

classes.name: WebBridge::Request
classes.description: Encapsulates a request with channel ID, sequence ID, and timestamp.

classes.name: WebBridge::Cleaner
classes.description: A worker pool job class responsible for cleanup operations within WebBridge.

classes.name: WebBridge::Config
classes.description: Configuration class for WebBridge, including timeout and bind address.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the given shell.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Processes inbound messages, either by identifier or by ID and message element.

methods.name: HasMethodSupport
methods.description: Checks if a method is supported in a specific version map.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Determines the destination state and handler based on a designator.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Registers an observer for a specific event.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an observer registration for a specific event.
